title: Chapter 204: The Great War Is Imminent
content:
Chapter 204: The Great War Is Imminent

Yu Guo, as the most popular protagonist in the world today, has single-handedly led the six kingdoms to join forces to fight against Qin, and the Qin country was very likely to unify the world, and the general trend of destroying the six kingdoms has become a precarious fate. Naturally, people from all over the world are pressing Watch closely.

And as a protagonist who is closely watched by the world, his every move affects the minds of countless people.

Now, such a protagonist, who mobilized countless people with such fanfare, seemed to be carrying out an ulterior purpose, which naturally aroused the curiosity of many caring people, as well as deep worries in their hearts.

One thing that can make a powerful country in the world consume so many manpower, expose its spies in various places, and mobilize countless materials to carry out, naturally it will not be some ridiculous exercises.

There must be a major secret that is unknown to everyone.

As the state of Qin, which is opposed to the six countries in the Kanto region, it regards the state of Yu as the enemy of life and death, Qin is either you die or I live.

He was naturally very curious about his opponent and the purpose of this action. Yingzheng sent out the imperial weapon snare, and the shadow guards who belonged directly to him to search around, but he couldn't find any clues at all, and he was in a fog.

In desperation, Ying Zheng could only let his spies continue to investigate the news. At the same time, based on the idea that what the enemy wanted, he could not get it, he kept using his dark power to destroy the actions of Yuguo, and tried his best to To prevent this unknown secret.

The spies belonging to the Qin Kingdom, the forces in the dark, rushed to the battlefield actively, and fought one after another with the secret guards of the Yu Kingdom who were in action.

Although these struggles are not as bloody and intuitive as on the battlefield, they are more dangerous and exciting. Every wrong step may cause the death of many people and the collapse of a small part of the formation.

However, if a small part of the formation loses its effect, although the impact on the whole is negligible, if some more small parts lose their effect, it will slowly drag down the operation of the formation and make the function of the formation incomplete.

And sending people to make up this formation again, not to mention time-consuming and labor-intensive, the materials that need to be consumed are also massive.

For today's Yuguo, these materials alone can be regarded as a heavy burden, and some special materials are not available in this world, and Yuguo's storage is not much, and once lost, there will be no more.

This is all unbearable for Zhong Yu. When a person dies, there are many things in this world, and they can be replenished at any time. What is needed is just a little time.

But if the supplies are gone, and there are no substitutes in this world, it will be fatal.

Therefore, Zhong Yu would rather die more people, send batch after batch of hidden guards at any cost, recruit batch after batch of masters from the country, and go to the front line to support, rather than want his plan to be affected.

Yu Guo suddenly increased its manpower and intensified its offensive, which made Qin's manpower a bit unbearable, and the battles in various places became more and more retreating.

This also makes all the forces in the world more certain that Yuguo's plan this time must not be small, and it can even affect the changes in the world.

The various forces couldn't help thinking secretly, what is so important, and the situation has become treacherous!

In the end, no matter how unwilling Yingzheng was, he had to withdraw from this competition. Qin had to guard against too many opponents, and did not support Yuguo, the six kingdoms of Shandong, and hundreds of schools of thought. It takes Qin Guo to spend a lot of thought to deal with it.

The power deployed on the battlefield before to fight against a country has consumed nearly 1/3 of Qin's dark forces, and has greatly collapsed all joints in Qin's darkness, making his dark power even weaker. Get dull.

Now that Yuguo has another increase in troops, how can this 1/3 of the dark forces resist the power of Yuguo and the whole country? Can only helplessly retreat.

Qin State, the only opponent who could play against Yue State, all retreated, and other forces naturally did not dare to stay longer.

The various countries in the alliance are now in their honeymoon period of cooperation, so naturally they will not come to add to the chaos, although secret attention is indispensable.

As for some other forces, since the state of Qi almost destroyed the country, its vitality has been greatly weakened, and it no longer has the intention to fight for world hegemony. Naturally, it will not add obstacles to the state of Yu, and recruit an opponent for itself.

As for the remaining schools, let alone, although their influence is great and their disciples are all over the world, they are not a country after all, and their organizational and mobilization capabilities are far inferior to a country with a complete war machine .

For this powerful country, which is one of the most powerful in the world, it is natural not to dare to offend him more, and add eye medicine to him.

Yuguo has nothing to do with Qin, but is there no way to deal with schools like him that belong to the common people?

Even within their sphere of influence, they only need to issue an order to prohibit their own school from disseminating academics, and it is enough for their own school to eat a pot.

Not to mention the encirclement and suppression by the large army and the encirclement and suppression by the dark forces will have enough power to destroy any school.

After all, every school is a competitor to each other. There is no less school in the world, and there is one more resource that can be obtained. Every school will not fail to understand this truth.

Therefore, without any obstruction, Yuguo's dark machine is making perfect preparations for the formation at the fastest speed.

Not long after, just half a year later, the layout of this large formation was finally completed on the vast battlefield.

With this incomparably huge formation, all the innocent souls who died on the battlefield will have a destination, that is the sharp sword that Zhong Yu is currently practicing, it will absorb the blood and soul of countless heroic warriors, and turn it into an incomparable sword. Nourishing food for it to grow and thrive.

Now that the preparations in advance have been completed, and the 350,000 troops are eating horses, and the countries that support their actions are a little bit overwhelmed, Zhong Yu plans to start his offensive.

In the past six months, the situation in the world is not only because of the actions of Yu Guo's family, but also attracts everyone's attention. Other countries also have their own stage, and perform his special skills on it.

On Qin's southern battlefield, Chu's 300,000 troops were pressing hard at every step. Although the guarding Qin army fought bravely and resisted to the death, they still couldn't hold back the large number of Chu soldiers, and there was a steady stream of support behind them.

In this war, as many people died in the front of the state of Chu, the king of Chu in the rear will make up as many people, so that the number of Chu troops has been maintained at around 300,000.

Finally, after paying the price of 200,000 deaths, the Chu army regained their old capital, which is the current capital of Nanjun, and renamed Jiangling City in Jiangling, and once again took back the land of thousands of miles in Nanjun from Qin.
